Graceful handling of empty bytes (should not error)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"bytes\":[],\"config\":{},\"filename\":\"empty.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
